summary: Iteration 5 RE-TEST of iteration-4 critical bug (PATCH /api/fancoils/{id} with empty/whitespace device_id persisting empty string). Ran existing /app/backend/tests/test_fancoil_device_id_edit.py — 6/6 passed. Added supplementary tests (whitespace device_id, PATCH without device_id field, in-memory state preservation) — 3/3 passed. Total 9/9 passed. Bug is fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: routes.py update_fancoil now correctly uses req.dict(exclude_unset=True) and validates device_id trimming BEFORE the branching — confirmed via tests: empty='' and whitespace='   ' both return 400 'Device ID não pode ser vazio'.

Potential flakiness in test_device_id_migration_full_flow when run interleaved with other tests: the alarms collection may receive new sim-generated alarm docs for the test device_id during the ~1s PATCH window. Passed in isolation and in parallel default workers, intermittently failed when sequentially mixed. Consider either (a) deleting the test fancoil doc BEFORE the simulator can generate alarms, or (b) asserting via a count snapshot captured just before PATCH.
seed_data_creation: Transient TST_mig_* and TST_state_* fancoils created and torn down inside tests. Verified post-run: CJ011 device_id=SIM0101, no TST_* docs remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 bug (empty/whitespace device_id persisted) is FIXED. All device_id edit scenarios validated: empty→400, whitespace→400, duplicate→400, same→200 no-op, new→200 with full history/command_log/alarms migration, PATCH without device_id field keeps device_id untouched, viewer/operator both 403. In-memory state (fields on GET) is preserved across device_id change.
rca of the issue: Fixed in iteration 5 by main agent in /app/backend/routes.py update_fancoil: switched to req.dict(exclude_unset=True) so unsent fields are not treated as empty strings, AND moved the empty/whitespace device_id validation BEFORE the 'if new_device_id != old_device_id' branching so that even same-value or no-op paths cannot persist an invalid value. Re-test confirms the fix.
